events.name: host_inventory
events.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$debugProcesses=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and ($_.Name -in @('hw_server.exe','vivado.exe','vitis.exe','xsdb.exe','xsct.exe') -or ($_.Name -eq 'pwsh.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine.Contains('capture_'+'uart.ps1'))) } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine,@{Name='CreationTimeFileTimeUtc';Expression={[string]$_.CreationDate.ToFileTimeUtc()}})
$ports=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_SerialPort | Select-Object DeviceID,Name,PNPDeviceID,Status)
$bridges=@(Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object { $_.InstanceId -match 'VID_0403&PID_6014|VID_10C4&PID_EA60' } | Select-Object Class,FriendlyName,InstanceId,Status,Problem)
$listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3121 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess)
[pscustomobject]@{observed_at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o'); serial_ports=$ports; usb_bridges=$bridges; debug_processes=$debugProcesses; listeners=$listeners; hardware_execution='NONE_THIS_QUERY'}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

events.name: owned_server_start
reviewed_ps_state_probe
events.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$runItem=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\22061\.codex\worktrees\96a3\FPGA_Competition\report\evidence\S2B-T06\ps_jtag_retry_20261009_120653_r01'
$probeItem=Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'ps_state_probe.py')
$vitisItem=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'D:\Xilinx\2026.1\Vitis\bin\vitis.bat'
if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $probeItem.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne '3bc3badff8df5f0654035f8fcaff3c797fbb8f00dd06e378aae706f10129e7a4') { throw '被审探针SHA改变' }
$probeOut=Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'ps_state_stdout.log'
$probeErr=Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'ps_state_stderr.log'
foreach ($path in @($probeOut,$probeErr,(Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'ps_state_result.json'))) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { throw '探针结果或日志已存在，拒绝覆盖' } }
$probeClock=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
& $vitisItem.FullName -s $probeItem.FullName 1> $probeOut 2> $probeErr
$probeExit=$LASTEXITCODE
[pscustomobject]@{ launcher_exit_code=$probeExit; elapsed_seconds=$probeClock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds; stdout=$probeOut; stderr=$probeErr; result=(Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'ps_state_result.json') } | ConvertTo-Json

note: 本Run是用户换JTAG后的全新记录；此处仅保存已执行的连接/停核读回，不声明PCB/profile、初始化、UART或DDR通过。
